newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end down on profit taking.

text.p: 1610 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended down on profit taking, following the lead set by U.S. Treasuries, after a strong start to the session in line with foreign markets, dealers said. *Sept 97 futures down 0.48 points to 110.90 *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.73 (103.05), yld 6.23 vs 6.18 cls *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 70 bps vs 69 bps
Portuguese bonds ended lower on profit taking, following the lead set by U.S. Treasuries, after a strong start to the session in line with other European markets, dealers said.
"Today the market took fright. Tomorrow we will see whether there is going to be a more sustained bout of selling," one operator said.
Another said: "After the start of profit taking in the U.S., Europe followed suit. Peripherals are more vulnerable and have difficulty finding support."
